Today I take another stab at actually writing a blog.
This time I'm trying out [Quarto](https://quarto.org/) as I want to be able to have code, LaTeX-like mathematics and citations, and good support and [MyST](https://mystmd.org/) isn't _quite_ there yet.
We'll see how this all goes and if I actually start to write again.

## Disclosure

To help get me over the time-hump of selecting a website platform and setting things up again I've used Claude Code's Opus 5.5 model to help scaffold Quarto.
